name: Hansa Teutonica: Big Box

categories.label: Prestige track
categories.help: Prestige points earned during play and marked on the track or scorepad.

categories.label: Fully developed abilities
categories.help: Abilities you have emptied completely, excluding City Keys (4 points each).

categories.label: Bonus markers
categories.help: Points from your collected bonus markers, used or not: 1 marker 1, 2-3 give 3, 4-5 give 6, 6-7 give 10, 8-9 give 15, 10 or more give 21.

categories.label: Special spaces
categories.help: Points from your merchant in the special end-game space on the map (for example Coellen).

categories.label: Controlled cities
categories.help: Cities where you hold the most trading posts (2 points each).

categories.label: Largest network
categories.help: Trading posts in your largest connected network multiplied by your City Keys value.

categories.label: Actions ability developed
categories.help: How far your Actions ability is developed; the fewest wins a tie.

notes: Read from the publisher-hosted English PDF; the text layer has duplicated lines on some pages but the end-game scoring and tie rules were legible. That rulebook states 3 to 5 players; the box and BoardGameGeek list 2 to 5 but no two-player rules were found in the PDF, so 3 to 5 is used. Tie-break: the player whose Actions ability is least developed wins, then the larger network score. Britannia and Eastern maps share the same scoring. Solo and variants excluded.
